value.rationale: An exact discrete-maximum-principle question for a canonical one-dimensional elliptic Poisson discretization and nonnegative compact tent/trapezoidal forcing. It identifies surprising peak-parity sensitivity, a sharp positive-parameter frontier valid uniformly for every grid length beyond support, asymptotic threshold law, and concrete exact negative integer-load example. It is more informative than a generic statement that CG may produce transient negative entries; meaningful limits are explicitly scoped.
